title: Charred Broccoli with Chili Crisp
summary: Broccoli blasted under the broiler or on the grill until the edges blacken, then tossed with chili crisp. Crunch and heat against a rich main.

ingredients.prep: cut into long florets, stems peeled and sliced

ingredients.note: with plenty of the solids, not just the oil

steps.title: Heat
steps.text: Broiler on high with a rack 5 inches from the element and a sheet pan preheating, or the hot zone of the grill with a grill basket.

steps.title: Oil and salt
steps.text: Toss the broccoli with the oil and salt. Keep it lightly coated; too much oil steams instead of chars.

steps.title: Char
steps.text: Spread in one layer and leave it alone until the tops blacken in spots, 6 to 8 minutes. Turn once and give it 3 to 4 more. You want real char on the florets with the stems still snappy.

steps.title: Dress
steps.text: Back in the bowl, hot. Toss with the chili crisp and soy sauce, squeeze the lemon over, and taste. If the main is already salty-sweet, the lemon is doing the most important work.

notes: Reconstructed from the cooking skill's record of the meal. If wasabi crema is also on the table, that is two heat sources; serve the crema on the side so people pick one.
